description: This file defines the LoginModel class for managing user login pages in an ASP.NET Core Razor Pages application, including authentication handling, external login schemes, and basket transfer logic.

classes.name: LoginModel
classes.description: PageModel class handling login process, including authentication, external schemes, and basket transfer.

classes.name: LoginModel.InputModel
classes.description: Inner class representing the login form data, including email, password, and remember me option.

methods.name: OnGetAsync
methods.description: Handles GET requests for the login page, initializes external schemes, and clears external cookies.

methods.name: OnPostAsync
methods.description: Handles POST request for login submission, authenticates user, manages lockout, two-factor, and basket transfer.

methods.name: TransferAnonymousBasketToUserAsync
methods.description: Transfers anonymous basket data to the authenticated user upon successful login.
